name: the-flow-ios
description: The iOS shell, its widget and watch app, and the Mac shell as one more target of the same Xcode project (ios/, committed, so Xcode Cloud can build every one of them). Kept out of the server's package.json on purpose — Render should not install a build toolchain it never runs. Capacitor is used once, to generate the project, and then removed: what ships is a plain Xcode project with no CocoaPods and nothing to resolve.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx cap add ios && node scripts/make-native.js && node scripts/add-widget-target.js && python3 scripts/add-watch-targets.py ios/App && node scripts/add-mac-target.js && node scripts/make-cloud.js
